$comment: The GPU group: the browser test files that need a REAL WebGPU adapter. They run only under `npm run test:gpu` (vitest.gpu.config.ts: serial, real GPU via Chromium launch args, own Vite cache) — the main browser suite runs them too, without GPU, and skips them with NO_WEBGPU_ADAPTER (tests/helpers/webgpu-adapter-skip.ts).

Criterion: the file guards its suite with skipEachWithoutAdapter(navigator.gpu.requestAdapter()). Files that only use `webgpu-gl` (WebGPURenderer on its WebGL backend, e.g. renderer-kinds, plan-763-webgpu-regressions) need no adapter and stay in the main suite only.

Every file of tests/webgpu-quarantine.json must be listed here, and every listed file must use skipEachWithoutAdapter (guard: tests/test-gpu-run.node.test.ts). Private entries (`../realvirtual-WebViewer-Private~/…`) are used only when the private sibling exists. Sorted by file.

gpuTests.why: WebGPU tracer capability probe (plan-553 F0) on a real device
path A motion blur on a real WebGPU device (plan-554 §9 GPU invariant)
cinematic render with the aux denoiser on a real WebGPU device
ray traced backend (trace scene, tracer data, kernel, history) on a real WebGPU device (plan-762 § 9.7)
MU compute transforms (plan-271 Phase 4) — compute shaders need the real 'webgpu' renderer kind
boots the complete demo on the real 'webgpu' renderer kind
